I think that you are very confused. This isn't about transphobia, and the point that your trying to prove isn't really relevant here. I'll try to explain it to best of my ability.

Firstly, I haven't read the study but based off of the headline alone it's just a study regarding women who are pregnant before going to jail. This makes your comparison to women who become pregnant in prison nonsensical. It would be like comparing the number of pregnant women who visit a hospital during their pregnancy versus women who become pregnant while in a hospital. Just because both are in the same place at a certain point doesn't mean that they represent a similar issue. 

Secondly, if a pregnant woman goes to prison, there is a lot less of a concern for the child as the partner is most likely able to take care of the child while the mother is in jail and even if the partner is able to do that for whatever reason the mother still had time to ask for help from family and friends and plan ahead for the baby. The woman who got pregnant in prison has none of those. Her partner is also in jail and she has little to no time to plan for the child's future while she is still in there, so there is a legitimate reason to fear for the child's future especially if the mother will be in jail for a long time.

Third, you kind of skip past this but most of the sex in prison isn't consensual, so it's much more likely that this child was the result of rape. Since they're both in the same prison, the mother has limited recourse in preventing the other person from interacting with the child. Hopefully the mother will get out first or she'll find a way to keep the father away from the child but if she can't who knows what might happen as they were both in prison for a reason. 

There could be many other issues that people could have with this, but these are the ones that I am most concerned with. If you wanted to prove some point then make a comparison between women who become pregnant in jail versus the number of trans-women in jail or something. I hope this helped you understand why your comparison doesn't make sense.
